geopolitics_summary: EU-Russia energy ties risk via Slovakia-Putin alignment; methane rule delays favour Big Oil; Ukraine refinery campaign pressures Trump leverage.

themes.headline: Big Oil delayed EU methane rules; further lobbying underway
themes.why_it_matters: Methane rule delays reduce upstream emissions oversight, easing supply-side cost for Russian gas entering EU via pipeline—risks TTF floor support and structural decarbonisation cost.

themes.headline: Russia plans to deepen ties with Slovakia under PM Fico
themes.why_it_matters: Slovakia is major transit hub for Russian gas to EU. Fico alignment with Putin heightens pipeline leverage risk and potential supply disruption volatility—direct impact on central/southern EU power spreads and gas curve.

themes.headline: Ukraine refinery campaign pressures Trump on war leverage
themes.why_it_matters: Sustained Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries tighten crude supply globally, raising Brent floor and crude-to-gas switching incentive in EU power stack—indirect upward pressure on power via fuel cost.

themes.headline: EU leaders summit agenda includes energy prices and climate rule tension
themes.why_it_matters: Summit outcomes on energy policy, green subsidies, and methane enforcement will signal EU commitment to carbon/power regulation. Potential delays or rollbacks affect EUA floor and renewables capex planning.

themes.headline: Germany, Italy seek emergency brake to halt new EU laws
themes.why_it_matters: Merz and Meloni push to block or slow EU laws via emergency mechanism. Could derail Green Deal enforcement, carbon cost calibration, and grid infrastructure directives—weakens long-term power market structure.

watchlist: EU leaders summit (Oct 15–16): energy price, methane rule, green subsidy decisions.
Slovakia–Russia energy negotiations: pipeline transit, supply security terms.
German–Italian emergency brake vote: timeline and scope of EU law suspension.
Ukraine refinery campaign impact on Brent crude and crude-gas arb spread.
